facts.fact: The ISO member page lists the Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality (EOS) as an ISO member body, with ISO membership obtained in 1957.

systems.country_label: Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality

EGY.note: TC participation counts are not tied to information technology committees.

facts.fact: ISO states a 1979 Presidential Decree reorganised EOS as the only official authority for standardization, quality control and metrology, elaborating national standards.

EGY.note: Certification schemes named cover products, not standards on information technology or data.
